title: Breaking News: EBAY latest news. - The Fly
text:
Fly Intel: What to watch in eBay earnings report » eBay (EBAY) is scheduled…
eBay (EBAY) is scheduled to report results of its third quarter after the market close on Tuesday, October 30, with a conference call scheduled for 6:00 pm ET. What to watch: 1. GROSS MERCHANDISE VOLUME: In the second quarter, eBay reported that its gross merchandise volume, or the amount of sales it helps facilitate, grew 10% on an as-reported basis, and 7% in constant currency, to $23.6B. This growth rate was down from the first quarter growth of 13% on a reported basis, and 7% in constant currency, following an increase in growth rate from the prior two quarters. Investors will be anxious to see if the company can re-accelerate GMV growth. 2. GUIDANCE: With its last report, eBay guided to Q3 adjusted earnings of 54c-56c per share. The consensus forecast, which was 56c at the time of the company's report, has slightly decreased to 54c. The company pointed toward Q3 revenue of $2.64B-$2.69B. The consensus forecast, which was $2.73B at the time, has dropped to $2.65B. 3. INITIATIVES AND PARTNERSHIPS: eBay has taken on a number of initiatives and partnerships to improve the user experience and visibility. In July, eBay announced it was rolling out Apple Pay (AAPL) acceptance on its Marketplace platform. The company said, "As eBay begins to manage payments on its Marketplace platform, Apple Pay will be among the first forms of payment offered in its new payments experience... the company is on track to start managing payments on a limited scale in the U.S. early this fall, at which time buyers will be able to use Apple Pay to purchase items from sellers participating in the initial phase of the new payments experience." Additionally in July, the company and Square Capital (SQ) announced partnership to enable eBay's sellers in the U.S. to access funding that can help them grow their businesses. "While many small businesses still struggle to obtain the financing they need, Square Capital will provide eligible eBay sellers with a simple, seamless, and transparent funding experience," the companies said in a statement. Additionally in September, the company said that "after the successful launch of [email protected] in Ireland in 2017, along with a work-from-home program in the StubHub business unit, eBay is now bringing [email protected] to the U.S." The company announced it was immediately hiring over 40 new [email protected] roles in Akron, OH and also inviting 80 existing customer service employees to join the [email protected] program. ANALYSTS BECOME BEARISH: On October 19, Stifel analyst Scott Devitt downgraded eBay to Hold saying PayPal's (PYPL) earnings release suggested weak eBay gross merchandise volume trends in Q3. The analyst estimated that PayPal currently processes around 75% of addressable eBay GMV and for Q3, PayPal suggests eBay's marketplace GMV grew 3.4% year-over-year adjusted for currency relative to the analyst's prior estimate of 7.2%. Further, Devitt expects eBay's multi-year transition to the Adyen payments platform "could be bumpy given the long history that buyers and sellers have working almost exclusively with PayPal on the eBay platform." On October 22, BofA/Merrill analyst Justin Post downgraded eBay to Neutral from Buy telling investors it is underperforming the eCommerce sector with "no easy fixes." Post notes Paypal's Q3 earnings release disclosed volumes associated with eBay only grew 3%, versus 6% in Q2, and the company said it expects eBay to communicate softness in the Marketplaces business in its Q4 guidance.
